theme_brief: বিচারক: one quiet Bengali chamber palette (tanpura, esraj, sitar, bansuri, harmonium). Four 240 s beds, one per quarter of film-01's scenes as `film --cues-job` spreads them (scenes 1-4, 5-9, 10-14, 15-19); looped by eav.mix.arrange_cues if narration runs longer. Ducked 19 dB under speech; silence at turns is the edit's job.
